UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: User profile and referral hierarchy attribution

contactPhone.description: User contact phone or WhatsApp information

workTrade.description: Primary work trade or casual gig category

tradeExperience.description: At least one work experience supporting the user's trade

tradeReference.description: At least one verifiable reference supporting the user's trade

avatar.description: Compressed user face selfie avatar data URL

uplineTenantEmail.description: Email of the tenant who receives referrals from this user (timegig2026@gmail.com for main tenant or user-sub downstream)

uplineTenantUid.description: UID of the direct referral tenant when referred by a referral tenant

trialStartedAt.description: Epoch timestamp when referral free trial was activated

trialEndsAt.description: Epoch timestamp when referral free trial expires

termsAcceptedAt.description: Epoch timestamp when user accepted Terms and Conditions on signup

ReferralLink.title: ReferralLink
ReferralLink.description: Public non-PII referral code mapping and tenant offer configuration for routing referrals

ownerUid.description: UID of the user who owns this referral link

ownerTier.description: Active tier of the link owner

displayName.description: Non-PII display label for the referrer

tenantFee.description: Configured monthly Tenant Sub fee in ZAR

userFee.description: Configured monthly User Sub fee in ZAR

companyFee.description: Configured monthly Company Sub fee in ZAR

trialDays.description: Configured free trial days for new Tenant/User referrals

companyTrialDays.description: Configured free trial days for new Company referrals

maxTenantSignups.description: Maximum allowed Tenant Sub signups (0 = unlimited)

maxUserSignups.description: Maximum allowed User Sub signups (0 = unlimited)

maxCompanySignups.description: Maximum allowed Company Sub signups (defaults to 10 for referral tenants; 0 = unlimited for main tenant)

currentTenantSignups.description: Current count of active/pending Tenant Sub signups

currentUserSignups.description: Current count of active/pending User Sub signups

currentCompanySignups.description: Current count of active/pending Company Sub signups

bankName.description: Tenant bank name for EFT transfers

bankBranchCode.description: Tenant bank branch or universal code

bankReferenceNote.description: Payment reference instructions for EFT transfers

approvalHoursEnabled.description: Whether approving submitted submissions is restricted to tenant working hours

approvalHoursStart.description: Working hours start time in 24h HH:MM format

approvalHoursEnd.description: Working hours end time in 24h HH:MM format

approvalWorkingDays.description: Comma-separated weekday indices (0=Sun..6=Sat) when tenant approves submissions

Submission.title: Submission
Submission.description: User verification and subscription submission routed to Main Tenant or Referral Tenant

feeAmount.description: Subscription fee amount configured by tenant at submission time

idDoc.description: Uploaded ID document metadata and data URL

popDoc.description: Uploaded proof of payment metadata and data URL

referrerCode.description: Referral code that originated this submission

targetTenantEmail.description: timegig2026@gmail.com when routed to Main Tenant (direct or via any User Sub); empty when routed to a Referral Tenant

targetTenantUid.description: UID of the Referral Tenant who owns and reviews this referral

Seeker.title: Seeker
Seeker.description: Public non-PII directory entry and offered service profile for Seekers view

avatar.description: Optional compressed selfie avatar data URL

serviceTitle.description: Service offered by the seeker for hire

serviceDescription.description: Brief description of the offered service

offeringService.description: Whether the seeker is currently offering services for hire

Gig.title: Gig
Gig.description: User-posted gig pinned at an exact map location

ownerId.description: UID of the user who created the gig

ownerName.description: Display name of the gig creator

ownerAvatar.description: Face selfie thumbnail data URL of the gig creator

requireIdDoc.description: Whether the gig owner requires applicants to submit an ID document

GigEngagement.title: GigEngagement
GigEngagement.description: Unique view or interest record on a gig post

userId.description: UID of viewing or interested user

Hire.title: Hire
Hire.description: Real-time hire workflow between a User and a Seeker with navigation, completion rating, and mutual cancellation reason

userName.description: Display name of the hiring user

seekerName.description: Display name of the hired seeker

rating.description: Star rating (1-5) given by hiring user on completion

cancelReason.description: Mandatory reason when cancelled by user or seeker

HireMessage.title: HireMessage
HireMessage.description: Real-time navigation chat message between hiring user and seeker

senderName.description: Display name of the message sender

SeekerRating.title: SeekerRating
SeekerRating.description: Verified star rating tied to a completed hire

GigApplication.title: GigApplication
GigApplication.description: Application submitted by an active non-tenant user to a posted gig

gigOwnerId.description: UID of the gig post owner

applicantId.description: UID of the applicant user (cannot be a tenant)

applicantAvatar.description: Optional face selfie thumbnail of applicant

idDoc.description: Optional ID document submitted by applicant when required by gig owner

Feedback.title: Feedback
Feedback.description: User-submitted app feedback routed to the Main Tenant inbox

userName.description: Display name of the submitting user

userTier.description: Subscription tier of the submitting user

userAvatar.description: Face selfie thumbnail of the sender

userStatus.description: Account status label of the sender

readByMainTenant.description: Whether Main Tenant has read this feedback

readAt.description: Epoch timestamp when Main Tenant read this feedback

replyMessage.description: Reply sent by Main Tenant to the tenant/user

repliedAt.description: Epoch timestamp of Main Tenant reply

repliedByUid.description: UID of Main Tenant who replied

repliedByName.description: Display name of Main Tenant who replied

repliedByAvatar.description: Face selfie thumbnail of Main Tenant who replied

Company.title: Company
Company.description: User or tenant business page pinned on the GiGs map with logo, backcover, hours, contact info, and reservations

ownerId.description: UID of the user or tenant who created the company page

ownerName.description: Display name of the company owner

ownerAvatar.description: Face selfie thumbnail of the owner

logoUrl.description: Uploaded company logo image data URL

backcoverUrl.description: Uploaded company backcover banner image data URL

acceptsReservations.description: Whether users can book a reservation

CompanyReservation.title: CompanyReservation
CompanyReservation.description: User reservation booking made on a Company Page

companyOwnerId.description: UID of the Company Page owner

userId.description: UID of the user booking the reservation

userName.description: Display name of the booking user

/users/{userId}.description: Stores user profiles and referral attribution

/referralLinks/{code}.description: Maps referral codes to owner UID, tier, fees, trial days, and signup caps without PII

/submissions/{submissionId}.description: Stores referral verification submissions scoped to target tenant

/seekers/{userId}.description: Stores non-PII seeker profiles and offered services for Seekers view

/gigs/{gigId}.description: Stores user-created gigs pinned to exact map coordinates

/gigs/{gigId}/views/{viewerId}.description: Tracks unique viewer engagement per gig post

/gigs/{gigId}/interests/{userId}.description: Tracks user interest toggles per gig post

/companies/{companyId}.description: Stores user/tenant company pages pinned to exact map coordinates

/companyReservations/{reservationId}.description: Stores reservation bookings created by users on Company Pages

/hires/{hireId}.description: Stores live hire requests, navigation coordinates, completion ratings, and cancellation reasons

/hires/{hireId}/messages/{messageId}.description: Stores live navigation chat messages between hiring user and seeker

/seekerRatings/{hireId}.description: Stores verified star ratings for seekers upon gig completion

/gigApplications/{appId}.description: Stores gig applications from non-tenant users

/feedback/{feedbackId}.description: Stores user feedback visible to the Main Tenant and the submitting user, including Main Tenant replies and read status
